title: TOPS core definitions (Go-TOPS local copy)
$comment: A local copy of the definitions the TOPS shared core will own: layer outcomes, run outcomes, law verdicts, reason codes, enforcement modes, the baseline ledger and the exemption record. The shared core replaces this file by a checked sync. Go-TOPS schemas reference these definitions and do not repeat them.

outcome.description: What one layer did in one run (§3.3).

runOutcome.description: The outcome of a whole run, in the report summary (§3.3). partial: nothing in range failed, but a required law was out of range.

verdict.description: What one law found in one run (§3.3).

enforcementMode.description: How floors and caps are applied (§6.7).

date.description: A calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD, UTC. The pattern checks the shape; check validates the day.

handle.description: A non-empty person or team handle.

exemption.description: One exemption record (§6.8). Expiry is required; there is no permanent exemption.

countByFile.description: A count per module-relative, slash-separated file path.

countByNameAndFile.description: A count per name (a linter or a law ID), then per file.

ledger.description: The debt ledger (§6.7): only what is over the line. An absent entry is held to its hard rule.

functions.description: CRAP score per function identity, for functions over the cap.

packages.description: Per package import path, for packages under the coverage floor.

findings.description: Findings of a linter that no law maps, per linter and file.

laws.description: Findings that make a law refuse, per law ID and file.

ack.description: //tops:ack comments and acks.yaml entries, per law ID and file.

exemptions.description: The number of live exemption records in the repo.

survivors.description: Unexplained survivors of the tier 2 whole-module mutation run, per file.

regression.description: One accepted regression, written by baseline --accept-regression.
